build_AttModel: build a grounded video description model with attention-based captioning using the AttModel class
run_AttModel_forward: run the AttModel forward pass with MLE training on segmented video features and ground truth sequences
run_AttModel_sample: run the AttModel sampling method to generate video captions from proposal features and masks
run_AttModel_beam_search: run beam search inference on the AttModel to generate top-k caption sequences for video clips
review_AttModel_grounder: review the AttModel grounder method that computes attention scores between text embeddings and visual region features
